description: Rules applied to every agent, whatever it is. Markers here are distinctive enough not to collide between tools.

rules.why: an animation frame at the start of the terminal title means a turn is running
a live elapsed-time counter. The counter is load-bearing: a bare status word also appears in finished output

rules.regex: (?i)(\(y/n\)|\[y/n\]|do you want to|allow this|approve this|permission to)
rules.why: blocked outranks working: a dialog may have a spinner running behind it, and your attention is what the status is for
